import json,traceback
src=open('/app/submission/main.py').read().replace("\nmain()\n","")
g={}; exec(compile(src,"m","exec"),g)
req=json.load(open('/app/tmp/fz/c1.json'))
req2 = dict(req)
states, edges, fair, names, start, n = g['parse_graph']([[[3]],[[3]]],2,1,1,req2)
done = g['done_flags'](states,2,1)
# reach
adj=[[] for _ in range(n)]
for eid,(s,lab,t) in enumerate(edges): adj[s].append((eid,t))
order=[start]; vis={start}; qi=0
while qi<len(order):
    u=order[qi]; qi+=1
    for eid,t in adj[u]:
        if t not in vis: vis.add(t); order.append(t)
reach=[False]*n
for u in order: reach[u]=True
print("done",done,"reach",reach)
# replicate LG
DECL=(1<<len(fair))-1
lbit={}
for i,(a,m) in enumerate(fair): lbit[a]=1<<i
liveb=[reach[s] and not done[s] for s in range(n)]
live=[s for s in range(n) if liveb[s]]
enm=[0]*n
for s,lab,t in edges:
    b=lbit.get(lab)
    if b: enm[s]|=b
print("enm",enm,"fair",fair)
idmap={s:i for i,s in enumerate(live)}
k=len(live); adjl=[[] for _ in range(k)]; mn=[]
for eid in range(len(edges)):
    s,lab,t=edges[eid]
    if s in idmap and t in idmap:
        b=lbit.get(lab)
        if b is None: adjl[idmap[s]].append(idmap[t])
        else:
            mid=len(adjl); adjl.append([]); mn.append((eid,b))
            adjl[idmap[s]].append(mid); adjl[mid].append(idmap[t])
for i in range(k): adjl[i].append(i)
comps=g['tarjan_subset'](list(range(len(adjl))), set(range(len(adjl))), adjl)
print("comps",comps, "k",k,"live",live)
# iterate EL by hand
ens=[0]*len(adjl); ys=[0]*len(adjl); ms=[0]*len(adjl)
for i in range(k):
    enm2=enm[live[i]]; ens[i]=enm2; ys[i]=(~enm2)&DECL
for j,(eid,b) in enumerate(mn):
    ys[k+j]=b; ms[k+j]=b
print("ys",ys,"ms",ms,"ens",ens)
EOF
